title: Test the Truth
description: When someone shares information: - Ask for clarity: "Where did you hear this?" or "What’s the source?" - Cross-check: Verify their claims with other evidence. - Stay neutral: Don’t assume truth or falsehood—investigate first. Example: A colleague makes a bold claim in a meeting. Instead of accepting it outright, request data or examples.
